The '''Battle of the Carosi system''' occurred after the [[Disaster at Deepspace Besh]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The Alliance made a significant strike against the Empire.<ref name="TEA" />
